title: Adding on to the mall thing, who else remembers something similar?
content: So a few days ago I came across a tiktok made by JakeKnowsNothing - about the "Mall World", and this triggered a few memories from me. I'll say this: The way he described it in his tiktok brought this memory first, of a dream I had: "or me, its more like a city that's kinda like Tokyo but not? There's a fair/carnival part, a school, then the outerskirts but time does not exist, what we have instead os a thing called "convergence" where all timelines meet, past present and future... anyone else remember this too?" but I was also trying to say, it looked more like it had "Technozen" vibes? Basically, I've had more than one dream about this place. There was an ocean and everything- \_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_ But I'll copy and paste exactly what I sent to my friend about it (this message was literally a year ago): "So basically what happened was, everybody was preparing for an eclipse-- I remember specifically being on this giant Island. I asked what time it was in the dream (I know that's probably a big fat no no don't do that) But instead of being met with no response in a confused look, A random stranger told me "We don't do time zones, We have convergence." So I didn't exactly understand what was going on so I just kind of wrote it off as weird? Anyways, the eclipse was about to start and all of a sudden, this tower showed up with a humanoid figure just before the eclipse. Once the eclipse happened though it was really pretty and everyone (including me) Have these weird glowing tattoos that swirled around like glittery dust? We had like three different solar eclipses in a row, one at dark, one at day, and one when the sky was deep purple. I think I woke up a little after the eclipse, because the rest is fuzzy." \_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_
